principle: These creative definitions guide agent-owned choices within requester meaning, not clinical classifications. Zero/off disables added treatment, never removes explicitly requested content or artistic judgment. Sensual and fetish levels describe their prominence in the whole image; creativity describes interpretive freedom and the depth of reconstruction and creative re-creation. Consider relevant open choices together, including garment and silhouette, material and texture, pose, expression, gaze, relationships, situation and action, space, light, viewpoint and composition. Prioritize choices central to the request and active controls, and explore how they support one coherent concept rather than treating them as unrelated decorations. Preserve requester-owned meaning and properties; an unspecified or partly specified choice stays open within its actual scope and is not fixed merely by convention or the initial draft. Neither scale measures exposure percentages, detail quotas, quality scores, or native image-model parameters. Higher intensity does not prescribe a garment, material, exposure or expression category. Creativity leaves style, extra props and surreal treatment open to the request and artistic judgment. Emphasis directs only active sensual and fetish axes without changing their intensities. Popular permits familiar appeal without requiring trend search; overt is an available expression, not the mandatory meaning of level three. Choose a coherent expression suited to this particular scene. Sensual and fetish may share the same expressive choice; neither requires changing every dimension or raising creativity.

sensual.definition: Broadly interpreted human attraction and desire, including everyday, popular, intimate, suggestive, seductive, and overt expressions.

levels.0: No added sensual treatment; preserve explicitly requested content.
levels.1: This expression is a subtle supporting quality.
levels.2: This expression is clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: This expression leads the image's appeal and direction. Develop it coherently through relevant open choices such as clothing and silhouette, pose, expression, situation and framing; consider their relationships without requiring a particular garment, exposure level or change in every dimension. The saved creativity level governs the scope of broader reconstruction, not whether open choices may express sensual appeal.

fetish.definition: The expression of distinctive sexual attraction or arousal associated with particular objects, bodily features, clothing, materials, roles, situations, behaviors, or sensory qualities carrying special erotic significance, interpreted broadly beyond conventional fetish aesthetics. The level describes the contribution of this attraction to the photograph's overall impression and direction.

levels.0: Add no fetishistic attraction; preserve explicitly requested content.
levels.1: Fetishistic attraction associated with a particular element or quality subtly supports the photograph's overall impression.
levels.2: Fetishistic attraction associated with a particular element or quality is clearly readable in the photograph.
levels.3: Fetishistic attraction associated with a particular element or quality leads the photograph's overall impression and direction. Develop it coherently through relevant open choices such as clothing, material, gesture, expression, situation and framing, and their relationships; preserve requester meaning and locks without prescribing exposure or a fixed aesthetic. The saved creativity level governs the scope of broader reconstruction, not whether open choices may express this attraction.

adult_appeal_emphasis.definition: Relative leadership of the active sensual and fetish axes within one coherent expression.

choice_descriptions.auto: Let the higher effective intensity lead; equal active intensities share leadership. Add no emphasis when both axes are inactive.
choice_descriptions.sensual_led: Let broad attraction and desire lead, with any active fetishistic attraction supporting the expression.
choice_descriptions.balanced: Give both active axes comparable influence within one coherent expression; separate styling details are not required.
choice_descriptions.fetish_led: Let fetishistic attraction associated with a particular element or quality lead, with any active sensual expression supporting it.

creativity.definition: Freedom to interpret unspecified choices and explore relationships within the request, including the depth of candidate-informed reconstruction and creative re-creation after the independent baseline is frozen. It changes exploration and authorial development, not requester ownership or candidate-adoption quotas.

levels.0: Realize the request directly, filling only what is needed for a coherent image. After retrieval, retain candidate-informed changes only when needed for faithful meaning, legibility or consistency; do not expand the scene merely to use material.
levels.1: Introduce restrained variations close to the requested direction. After retrieval, consider local additions, replacements or subtractions with a concrete expressive benefit, keeping the overall direction close to the request.
levels.2: Actively reinterpret connected open choices central to the request and active controls into a coherent authorial direction, including relevant relationships among clothing, pose, expression, situation and other visual choices. After retrieval, develop candidate-informed alternatives that reorganize connected authorial choices, including replacement and subtraction rather than only local additions.
levels.3: Boldly reinterpret open choices and their relationships across the photograph while preserving every requester requirement. Explore creative re-creation: develop a distinct whole-photograph concept from the required meaning, not merely a rearrangement or decoration of the initial staging. Consider the structure and wearing of a garment when clothing is central and those properties are open, alongside relevant pose, expression, situation, relationships and visual form. After retrieval, actively develop complete reconstructions and re-creations informed by compatible candidate material, substantially replacing agent-authored staging when the new concept serves the requested freedom. When locked scope or source prerequisites prevent a distinct viable re-creation, record the actual reason and choose among the viable options, including the baseline. Do not prescribe a minimum adoption count or rewrite percentage.

viewer_experience.definition: Expose the detailed viewer-experience review when enabled. Always consider the intended impression in interpreted_intent, even when this additional review is off.

reference_edit_mode.definition: Use the selected reference-edit workflow only within the requester's reference-use scope. Record that scope in the core; a face/hair reference does not lock clothing, body shape or composition and does not prove identity. Off does not discard a supplied reference.

surreal.definition: Added departures from ordinary reality, interpreted broadly across space, scale, causality, materials, and atmosphere, including dreamlike, uncanny, symbolic, and impossible relationships.

levels.0: No added surreal treatment; preserve explicitly requested fantasy and impossible elements.
levels.1: Surreal qualities are a subtle supporting presence.
levels.2: Surreal qualities are clearly readable in the image.
levels.3: Surreal qualities lead the image's main impression and direction; a single coherent relationship may carry this prominence.

trend_layer.definition: Consider the chosen treatment from the initial composition. Refine it later without adding it twice. Off does not remove a treatment explicitly present in the request.
